name: Namchow Food Group (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Namchow Food Group (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. engages in the development, production, processing, and sale of edible oil and dairy products in China and internationally. It offers baking oil and fat; light cream; pre-made baked goods; pre-packaged food, including frozen and refrigerated food; frozen dough, fillings, etc. It is also involved in wholesale and import/export of edible oil; trading; and online retail business, as well as provision of related supporting services. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Shanghai, China. Namchow Food Group (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Namchow (Cayman Islands) Holding Corp.
